facts.fact: The order is made under the Code du numérique (Ordonnance-loi 23/010 of 13 March 2023), citing its articles as the legal basis for the authorisation regime.
facts.system: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du Numérique

facts.fact: The order of 11 March 2026 sets the authorisation regime for qualified trust-service providers (electronic signature, seal, time-stamp, archiving, certification, website authentication, registered delivery, cryptology), marketplaces and e-commerce platforms; it enters into force on signature, with full application from 1 July 2026.

note: The text states no authorisation actually issued.
